settings.heading: What's the best way to thaw your juices and smoothies?
settings.text: Your bottles should arrive frozen. Store the bottles in your freezer until you are ready to start drinking them. Thaw out the number of bottles you plan on drinking each day by putting them in your refrigerator. Thawing may take 24-48 hours depending on how cold your refridgerator is. Once thawed, bottles should remain refrigerated and be consumed within 24 hours.

settings.heading: Can I leave the juices at room temperature?
settings.text: No, our products need to be kept frozen until you are ready to consume them because they have a very short shelf life. Thaw the bottles in the refrigerator. Thawing may take up to 48 hours depending on how cold your refrigerator is. Once completely thawed our products must be consumed within 24 hours. Our juices taste best when consumed very cold. Shake bottles before you consume.

settings.heading: My order arrived partially thawed. Is it safe to drink, and/or refreeze?
settings.text: Yes! Partial thawing in transit is normal. As long as there is some ice in the bottles, they are at the safe temperature to either consume right away or put into the freezer for later consumption. Also, if you have yet to try one of our drinks partially thawed, we highly recommend it. It's like drinking a slushy.

settings.heading: Shelf Life & Thawing
Why should I do a juice cleanse?
settings.text:
From time to time it is good to give your body a rest from the stresses of everyday life. We can't control everything, but we can control what we put in our mouths. Juice cleansing is a good way to:

  • Give your digestive system a break so your body can heal and repair itself quickly
  • Feed yourself pure nutrition that your body can absorb immediately
  • Help your liver and kidneys detoxify your body
  • Give your body what it needs to slim down and have more energy

settings.heading: What are some symptoms of a toxic diet?
settings.text:
When you eat an unhealthy diet of fried foods, dairy, wheat, coffee, and alcohol you start to not look and feel your best. But it's hard to get out of that rut. Here are some symptoms you might experience if you don't have enough plants in your diet:

  • Weight gain (especially around your abs)
  • Junk food cravings
  • Water retention
  • Bloating
  • Chronic fatigue
  • Trouble sleeping
  • Brain fog
  • Skin issues like acne, eczema, and dry skin

settings.heading: What are the benefits of doing a juice cleanse?
settings.text:
When you give your body nothing but pure nutrition from plants that it can absorb easily and quickly, you start to feel the effects immediately. Many people experience the following during and after a juice cleanse:

  • Rapid weight loss 
  • Bloating eliminated
  • More energy
  • Clear bright skin
  • Powerful workouts
  • Deeper sleep
  • Stronger immune system

settings.heading: How often should I do a juice cleanse?
settings.text:
It all depends on your personal situation, and we notice there is a range of different frequencies that our customers do a juice cleanse:

  • At a minimum, it is beneficial to cleanse once every three months (a lot of people like to time this with the changing of the seasons).
  • Once a month to keep your health and weight loss goals on track.
  • Once a week (3-5 days) for a month or longer for more serious health and weight loss goals.
  • The ultimate juice cleanse: every day for 2+ weeks. Yes, this is healthy as long as you are getting enough of a variety of plants. You can supplement our juices with raw fruits and vegetables or protein smoothies.

settings.heading: How should I prepare for my cleanse?
settings.text: To get the best results cut out dairy, meat, and grains a few days before you cleanse. At a minimum, eat plant-based foods the day before, emphasizing lots of vegetables.

settings.heading: How often should I drink each bottle?
settings.text: Drink the bottles as you become hungry. If you find you don’t need all 6 bottles daily, save the extras to extend your cleanse or to use as a snack or meal replacement after your cleanse.

settings.heading: Why is cleansing effective?
settings.text: Juicing extracts the liquid portion of a plant and easily maximizes the nutrients we take into our bodies. Nothing is more nutritious and absorbable than raw juice. The enzymes in raw juice digest our food and turn it into fuel - all while removing harmful toxins and increasing immunity to sickness and disease. The vital nutrients from juice quickly reaches your organs, resets your body, re-oxygenates your blood, flushes out fat, neutralizes the unhealthy, disease-promoting acidic state caused by the typical American diet, and helps you take control of your health and well-being.

settings.heading: In what order should I drink the bottles?
settings.text: There is no right or wrong order. It is totally up to you and what you’re feeling. However, we recommend starting your day with a green juice.

settings.heading: What if I am hungry during my cleanse?
settings.text: If 6 bottles a day is not enough for you, try eating raw fruit and/or vegetables. If you are still hungry try a plain baked sweet potato or some lightly steamed veggies. Go easy on added salt.

settings.heading: Should I be drinking water?
settings.text: Yes, drink water as often as you need to.

settings.heading: Can I drink coffee and tea?
settings.text: Yes, but drink it without any cream or sugar. If you cannot drink your coffee black we suggest swapping sugar with a monk fruit sweetener and replacing cream with oat milk or another dairy free plant-based milk.

settings.heading: Will I need to be close to a restroom?
settings.text:
Unlike extreme cleanses on the market, our juices are designed to gently cleanse your body. Visits to the restroom could be more frequent due to increased fluid intake, but should not require urgency. Continue your normal daily activities without worry. In rare cases, increased bowel movements may occur.

In order to reduce the likelihood of cleansing side effects, make sure to ease into a cleanse with our pre-cleanse tips.

settings.heading: How & Why to Cleanse
What is the difference between a cleanse and a method?
settings.text:
Cleanses and methods are two different ways to reset your body and lose weight.

Both are nutritionist-designed to work with your body, NOT against it.

  1. Cleanses are best for fast results in just 3–10 days. You’ll lose weight quickly, reset cravings, reduce bloating, and detoxify your body.  Cleanses are perfect when you need a clean break from unhealthy eating habits.
  2. Methods are for sustainable results you can maintain. These weekly programs combine juices, smoothies, and structured meal guidelines to help you lose 2–3 pounds per week, reset digestion, and build long-term habits you can stick with.

settings.heading: How much weight can I expect to lose with a method?
settings.text: The average reported weight loss is 2 to 3 pounds per week.

settings.heading: Can I eat full meals while following a method program?
settings.text: Absolutely, you will be eating meals with these method programs. In addition to the juices, smoothies, and functional shots, you’ll receive easy-to-follow healthy eating tips from our in-house nutritionist and clear guidance for meals and snacks. You’ll learn how to eat in a way that supports weight loss, energy, and well-being.

settings.heading: Can I drink your products while pregnant or breastfeeding?
settings.text:
Yes. However, we do not recommend doing a juice cleanse, or any other type of cleanse, while you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It is important not to restrict your calorie intake during this time. We think adding in fresh, raw juices and smoothies to your daily diet can be a wonderful thing!

Our products are made only from real fruits, vegetables, nuts, seeds, and spices, and are great to incorporate into your diet as a snack when pregnant and breastfeeding. If you are concerned at all about consuming raw juices we suggest consulting your doctor.

settings.heading: Can I maintain my exercise routing while following a method?
settings.text: Yes, we recommend regular physical activity and maintaining your normal workouts while using the methods. The juices, smoothies, and shots provide lean healthy carbohydrates, protein, and fats to support muscle recovery and fuel your body.

settings.heading: What if my weight loss plateaus?
settings.text:
When it comes to weight loss, every so often it is good to change up your routine and/or your diet. This shakes up your system and can often get you over a weight loss plateau.

The healthiest way to break through a plateau is with a juice cleanse. Not only will you shed unwanted weight with a juice cleanse, you'll also be flooding your body with the vital nutrients it needs.

settings.heading: How the Method Programs Work
Are your juices cold pressed?
settings.text: Yes, our juices are cold pressed.

settings.heading: Are your juices blended?
settings.text: No, our juices are NOT blended. However, we do offer smoothies that are blended.

settings.heading: What is the difference between juicing and blending?
settings.text: The difference between juicing and blending is this... when you blend fruits & vegetables you are using (mostly) the entire plant. The fiber is included in the mixture and it has a thicker consistency. When you juice fruits & vegetables the fiber is removed and it has a fluid consistency.

settings.heading: Can I drink your products while pregnant or breastfeeding?
settings.text: Yes. However, we do not recommend doing a juice cleanse, or any other type of cleanse, while you are pregnant or breastfeeding. It is important not to restrict your calorie intake during this time. We think adding in fresh, raw juices and smoothies to your daily diet can be a wonderful thing! Our products are made only from real fruits, vegetables, nuts, seeds, and spices, and are great to incorporate into your diet as a snack when pregnant and breastfeeding. If you are concerned at all about consuming raw juices we suggest consulting your doctor.

settings.heading: Are your juices pasteurized?
settings.text: No. We do not pasteurize or High Pressure Process our products. Rather, we flash freeze them because it is the best way to keep the beneficial vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, and enzymes in tact. Pasteurization and other juice preservation techniques like HPP destroy or degrade the inherent nutritional content of the juice. Enzymes in particular, which are vital for transporting nutrients, repairing tissues, removing toxins, and more, are totally decimated by pasteurization and HPP.

settings.heading: Why do you ship the product frozen?
settings.text: It's the only way to truly preserve and lock in flavor, nutrients, and enzymes. Other brands essentially cook out all these good things with their processing methods. Not us. This is as close to juicing at home as you will get. And even better, because you don't have to do any work. And the fact that they arrive frozen means you can enjoy them whenever you want... no more rushing to drink them before they go bad.

settings.heading: Can I drink these if I have nut and seed allergies?
settings.text: Our products are made in a facility that stores and processes nuts and seeds. You can see the allergen information on the back label of each bottle. We do our absolute best to minimize any cross-contamination risk. If you have any additional concerns please reach out to our support team.

settings.heading: Are your products organic?
settings.text: We source as many organic ingredients as we can. All organic ingredients are specified on the ingredient lists on the back labels of each product. Although we are not certified organic, our produce is delivered fresh daily from a local chemical-free facility. We never use any harsh chemicals during the cleaning or pressing process of the produce once it is in our hands.

settings.heading: Are your products certified Kosher?
settings.text: Some of our products are certified Kosher through EarthKosher, an internationally recognized certification agency. You can view our current Kosher Certificate below. Not all flavors are certified, so please confirm that the flavor you’re purchasing is listed on the certificate itself. Download the Kosher Certificate (PDF).

settings.heading: Are your products Halal?
settings.text: Select products are certified Halal through the American Halal Foundation and produced in accordance with Islamic dietary guidelines. You can view our current Halal Certificate here. Not all products are certified, so please refer directly to the certificate to verify whether a specific product is included.

settings.heading: I'm allergic to an ingredient in a cleanse. Can I substitute flavors?
settings.text: Unfortunately, we cannot make any customizations or substitutions to the flavor combinations in the cleanses and methods; however, we do have the Build A Box for you to select the combination of juices you would like. https://www.rawgeneration.com/products/build-a-box-1

How long does delivery take?
settings.text: Generally, shipping takes 1-3 business days. However, this does not take into account time to process the order, and where you live in the country might affect the delivery time. We are based in New Jersey and we process orders first come, first serve. All orders are shipped Monday - Friday. If you order later in the week and there are not enough days in transit to allow for the package to arrive by Friday (commercial address) or Saturday (home delivery), your order will be held for shipment until the following week.

settings.heading: Do I need to be home to receive my order?
settings.text: Each package is shipped in an insulated box and will withstand sitting until you return home. Due to the perishable nature of our products, we ask that you open the package immediately upon arrival and to place the contents in your freezer or refrigerator. If you are ordering as a gift, do not worry - all of our packages are marked "keep frozen" and "perishable".  In addition, each package contains a brochure with instructions for proper handling.

settings.heading: Do you offer same day delivery?
settings.text: At this time we do not offer same day delivery. We do our best to get every order out as quickly as possible. Once your order is processed for shipment you will receive an email including your Fedex tracking number.

settings.heading: Does free shipping apply to Hawaii and Alaska?
settings.text: At this time we are not able to offer free shipping to Hawaii and Alaska for one time and subscription orders. Please see the shipping calculator at checkout for an accurate cost of shipping to you if you live in Hawaii or Alaska.

settings.heading: Do you ship internationally?
settings.text: At this time we only ship to the United States, including Hawaii and Alaska.

settings.heading: Will I be notified when my order ships?
settings.text: Once your order is processed for delivery you will receive a confirmation email with the Fedex tracking number.

settings.heading: Are there any shipping restrictions?
settings.text: We cannot deliver on Sundays or Mondays or to P.O. Boxes or A.P.O. and F.P.O. addresses.

settings.heading: I didn't receive my order but it says it was delivered. What do I do?
settings.text:
If your tracking information states your package was delivered, but you do not have it, you would have to contact FedEx and file a claim for a missing package. Once you have a claim number, you can send that over to us and we are happy to send out a replacement or issue you a refund, whichever option you would prefer. If you would like a replacement sent, please verify your shipping address.

To file a claim, follow the FedEx instructions here: File a Claim.
